json_ld.description:
The Discbound Journal Bundle Includes:

1 Discbound Journal
3 Paper Refills (60 pages each)
1 Journal Archive

Buy it once. Refill it for life. This discbound journal combines the flexibility of a ring binder with the elegance of a bound notebook. The open-source disc binding system lets you easily add, remove, and rearrange pages, making it endlessly customizable. We've elevated this proven system using premium materials: solid brass discs, smooth 70# dot grid paper, and sturdy cardstock covers, all crafted in the USA.
Refill packs available here
